system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"<USER> Hi spotify, I am having trouble using the Family membership feature. One of the members does not appear to be getting invites even although they have had an account for several years previously. Can you help?"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! We can definitely help with that. Please DM us the details, and we'll take a closer look! Let us know how it goes /AI"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Requesting a DM is good, but 'Let us know how it goes /AI' is informal and unclear."}
